query: USMCA joint review July 1 2026 outcome - did US provide written notice of withdrawal under Article 34.6? Latest news on Trump USMCA withdrawal or renewal decision June-July 2026
answer:
**Summary:** No — the US did **not** provide written notice of withdrawal under **Article 34.6** at the July 1, 2026 USMCA joint review.

What happened instead: USTR Jamieson Greer announced the US **declined to extend/renew** the USMCA "in its current form," while Canada and Mexico supported a 16-year extension. This non-extension triggered the **annual joint review process under Article 34.7.4** — legally distinct from withdrawal. The agreement remains **fully in force** (all tariffs, rules of origin, dispute mechanisms unchanged) through its current term ending **July 1, 2036**, with mandatory annual reviews until then.

Legal analyses (National Law Review, White & Case, Brownstein) are explicit: Article 34.6 withdrawal requires **written notice effective 6 months after delivery**, and **the US has not issued such a notice**. As of mid-July 2026, no withdrawal notice has been reported. Next step: a third bilateral US–Mexico negotiating round the week of July 20, 2026 in Mexico City.
